other_conditions: Benefit is available only for the marriage of two adult girls from the same family
Remarriage is not eligible for the scheme
Application for assistance must be submitted within two years of the marriage
Beneficiary girls must be part of the Sat Fera Samuh Lagna Yojana
Girls participating in group marriages are eligible only if they also satisfy the conditions of the Sat Fera Samuh Lagna Yojana
benefits_summary: Provides ₹12,000 financial assistance for Scheduled Caste girls marrying after 01‑04‑2021, or ₹10,000 for those marrying before that date.
